configuredRun.diagnosticStreamPurpose: stderr carries exported model results/operations, not errors; one CLI import only.

scope: Analytic finite-linear-acceleration/braking path schedule on known schematic controls. Angular rate changes still instantaneous. No timed dynamics/controller/collision/energy/hardware calibration or globally fastest route; model seconds are not measured time. Every-waypoint sampling changes requested stops by design. X ties, so strict improvement on every route is not established.
